fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run TestBriefFiles shows a session's brief.md naming the change set, its intent, every leaf with its acceptance, the decisions and constraints, prePushCheck and the contract section, slice.json equal to rhiza slice --json at start, and handback.md written only on a hand-back with the failing tests or conflicted files; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/brief-files passes, a failure case included (an unreadable run directory fails the session start with a message naming the path).
fields.statement: Before every agent session of a run, the daemon writes the session's context into the run's directory: brief.md (the change set and its intent, the leaves with their acceptance, the decisions and constraints, the repo's check commands and the agent contract), slice.json (rhiza slice --json for the change set at that moment) and, on a hand-back only, handback.md (the cause from rhiza ship check --json).

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestInvokeTemplate covers parsing, an unknown placeholder refused by rhiza workflow check with its name, and prompt as an alias; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/workflow-invoke shows a fake agent receiving '/myskill:conduct --prompt <path to brief.md>' and the three RHIZA_ variables; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden passes after -update.
fields.statement: An agent step can name the exact text its session starts with (invoke) and the text a hand-back sends it (handback), with the placeholders {brief}, {slice}, {handback}, {change}, {run}, {leaf}, {attempt} and {worktree}; the daemon fills them in, sets RHIZA_BRIEF, RHIZA_SLICE and RHIZA_HANDBACK, and the agent's adapter delivers the text; prompt stays an alias of invoke.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run TestContract shows the topic lists each obligation with its gate, every placeholder, every RHIZA_ variable and the three files, stays under the guide size cap, and that every shipped role topic (builder, verifier, review, plan, conduct once it exists) names rhiza guide contract.
fields.statement: rhiza guide contract prints the agent contract on one page: what any agent in a run must do (write the model only through rhiza, the Change:, Actor: and Leaf: trailers, Evidence on every leaf, findings through rhiza run findings, questions through rhiza, rhiza session done), which gate checks each, the invoke placeholders and RHIZA_ variables, and the three context files; every shipped role skill links it.
